upstream_test: custom: task-owned H2_COOL deck (Dissociative wall shock with H2_COOL (ideal EOS, RK3)); no official Test_Problems configuration exercises this path; agreed by the owner when the legacy leaf was merged
configuration: PHYSICS=HD; 1D CARTESIAN; 300 zones; solver hllc; LINEAR reconstruction; RK3 time stepping; COOLING=H2_COOL; tstop 0.1; CFL 0.8; dbl output '0.025 -1 single_file'
variant: ic/variant/pluto.ini multiplies [Parameters] N0 by (1 + 1e-15): 1.0 becomes 1.000000000000001, one ulp of a value the initial condition is built from (init.c reads g_inputParam[N0]). Every initial value that depends on it moves at round-off while the physics is unchanged, so the two runs differ by rounding only and their spread is the floor of this check.
altbuild: the same pinned source built with make CFLAGS='-c -O0' using the unchanged Linux.gcc.defs architecture instead of its -O3 CFLAGS: a build a correct candidate could plausibly be, with no change of source or deck

comparison.files: grid.out (cell edges under the bound), the frame set dbl.out declares (a gate), and the final data.NNNN.dbl frame at t = tstop: every variable, staggered components included, plus its time; intermediate frames are reported, not graded, because PLUTO writes them at the first step past the dump time (Src/main.c, CheckForOutput) and two correct runs do not share that time
comparison.rule: abs(candidate - reference) <= atol + rtol * abs(reference) for every value

evidence.floor_how: nominal versus variant, sab.py task selfcheck run 20260902T091428Z (2026-09-02T09:17:56Z): largest absolute difference over every graded value 1.24e-10, largest relative difference 2.12e-13, verdict under the provisional bound: pass; measured runtime 7 s on the nominal solve with the whole suite running concurrently on 16 cores. The legacy leaf recorded two independent single-rank runs of the same binary as byte-identical.

warrant: The graded observable is the state PLUTO writes for this configuration (every variable of the final dbl frame at t = tstop, its time and the grid edges; intermediate frames must exist but are not graded, because PLUTO writes them at the first step past the dump time (Src/main.c, CheckForOutput) so their physical time depends on the step sequence), compared value by value under |candidate - reference| <= 1e-8 + 1e-8|reference|, the bound the owner approved for the merged PLUTO leaves (PR #300) and kept here as the calibration hypothesis. What the check exercises: reflected 40 km/s shock in cold molecular gas: H2 dissociation (kr2/kr3/kr4), partial ionisation (ci/cr), Glover & Abel molecular/atomic cooling and gas-grain term; stiff adaptive Cash-Karp path with the |k1[RHOE]| > 0.5/dt stiffness switch; X_H2 <= 1/2 clamp and three-species conservation; RK3 with split cooling; steady inflow boundary. The bound is physical because a faithful port differs from the reference only by rounding while the nearest real fault lands orders of magnitude above it: a port with wrong rate coefficients or table range clamps, species sum not conserved, wrong substep control in the stiff branch moves the graded state by 1e-3 to 1e-1 relative over many cells. It is achievable because the state is double precision end to end (Src/structs.h:524, the Vc array) and two legitimate runs differ only in the order of floating-point operations; the relative term sits one decade above the 1e-9 branch thresholds where a rounding difference can flip a solver decision (Src/HD/hllc.c:169, Src/MHD/hll.c:161, Src/MHD/eigenv.c:298, the small_p and small_rho floors of Src/HD/two_shock.c:29), and the absolute term is the measured floor of the components that are zero or near zero in these configurations: the calibration runs of 2026-09-02 put round-off noise on such components at 1e-11 to 4e-9 after 1e2 to 1e4 steps (a one-ulp shift of the time-step sequence times the local gradient), so 1e-8 sits a decade above that floor and five orders below any fault, while the relative term still governs every field of order unity. The measured floor of this check is the nominal-versus-variant spread recorded in evidence; where that spread exceeds the bound the policy is revised from the number, never loosened by hand.
